title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Drake University
description: Navigate the late-night landscape near Drake University, from 24-hour convenience hubs to student-driven alcohol-alternative events and off-campus diners.

cards.title: Spike's C-Store
cards.subtitle: Olmsted Center
cards.notes: Visit this on-campus convenience store for frozen meals and snacks. It remains open until midnight daily, serving as a primary late-night food source for residential students.
cards.short_summary: The primary on-campus late-night convenience store located in the Olmsted Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Spike's C-Store is open until midnight every day, providing food options after the dining hall closes.
cards.source_title: Hubbell Dining Hall shortens hours, now closes at 8:30 daily - The Times-Delphic
cards.access_notes: Open until 12:00 AM daily during the academic semester.

cards.title: Drake Diner
cards.subtitle: Cottage Grove Avenue
cards.notes: Order classic comfort food at this retro-style diner located just south of campus. It is a neighborhood landmark known for serving breakfast all day in an upscale atmosphere.
cards.short_summary: A landmark retro diner south of campus serving classic American comfort food.
cards.evidence_claim: The Drake Diner is a Des Moines landmark located just south of the Drake University campus.
cards.access_notes: Open until 10:00 PM on Friday and Saturday; 9:00 PM other nights.

cards.title: QuikTrip on University
cards.subtitle: University Avenue
cards.notes: Stop by this 24-hour hub for grab-and-go pizza, taquitos, and fountain drinks. It serves as a reliable off-campus destination for students needing fuel or snacks at any hour.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour convenience store and gas station frequently used by students for late-night snacks.
cards.evidence_claim: QuikTrip locations, including the one at 614 University Ave, are open 24 hours.

cards.title: Dogtown After Hours
cards.subtitle: Olmsted Center
cards.notes: Participate in this annual alcohol-alternative event featuring free food, games, and student performances. It is designed to provide a safe, late-night social environment.
cards.short_summary: An annual student-driven alcohol-alternative event held late into the night.
cards.evidence_claim: Dogtown After Hours is an alcohol-alternative program that takes over the Olmsted Center with free activities and food.
cards.source_title: Dogtown After Hours (DTAH) - Drake University Calendar
cards.access_notes: Annual spring event; typically runs late into the evening.

cards.title: Dough Co. Pizza
cards.subtitle: Dogtown District
cards.notes: Grab a New York-style slice at this local pizza shop in the Drake neighborhood. It is a popular spot for students looking for a late meal near the campus perimeter.
cards.short_summary: A local pizza shop in the Drake neighborhood serving New York-style thin crust.
cards.evidence_claim: Dough Co. Pizza serves New York style thin crust pizza in the Drake neighborhood of Des Moines.
cards.access_notes: Open until 10:00 PM on Friday and Saturday.

cards.title: Abelardo's Mexican Fresh
cards.subtitle: East Euclid Avenue
cards.notes: Drive through for authentic tacos and burritos at this regional favorite. Known for its late-night availability, it is a go-to for students with late-night cravings.
cards.short_summary: A popular Mexican fast-food spot known for being open late for drive-thru orders.
cards.evidence_claim: Abelardo's Mexican Fresh is advertised as being open late for late-night cravings.
cards.source_title: Open late for those late-night cravings - Abelardo's Mexican Fresh
cards.access_notes: Many locations open until 12:00 AM or later.

cards.title: Perkins on Euclid
cards.subtitle: East Euclid Avenue
cards.notes: Meet for late-night pancakes or pie at this 24-hour weekend destination. It provides a classic sit-down environment for study breaks or post-event meals.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour weekend restaurant and bakery serving breakfast and comfort food.
cards.evidence_claim: The Perkins on E Euclid Ave is open 24 hours on Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Perkins at 2425 E Euclid Ave. Des Moines, IA
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours on Friday and Saturday; until 12:00 AM other days.

cards.title: Casey's Pizza Run
cards.subtitle: Northwest 6th Drive
cards.notes: Order a signature breakfast pizza or a late-night pie from this Iowa staple. The 24/7 pumps and late kitchen hours make it a frequent stop for student commuters.
cards.short_summary: A regional convenience store chain famous for its pizza, with 24/7 fuel access.
cards.evidence_claim: Casey's offers pizza delivery and pickup with 24/7 pump access at various Des Moines locations.
cards.source_title: 6565 Nw 6th Dr - Pizza Delivery and Pickup | Casey's
cards.access_notes: Pumps open 24/7; kitchen typically open until 10:00 PM or 11:00 PM.

cards.title: Cowles Library
cards.subtitle: University Avenue
cards.notes: Utilize the study spaces in the main campus library during finals week when hours are often extended. It is the central hub for late-night academic preparation.
cards.short_summary: The main university library providing late-night study spaces for students.
cards.evidence_claim: Cowles Library provides study spaces and typically operates until 1:00 AM or later during peak academic periods.
cards.source_title: Opening Hours - Cowles Library - Drake University
cards.access_notes: Standard hours until 1:00 AM; 24-hour access often provided during finals.

cards.title: Starbucks at Olmsted
cards.subtitle: Olmsted Center
cards.notes: Grab a late-evening caffeine fix at this on-campus Starbucks. It serves as a social and study anchor in the student union until its nightly closing.
cards.short_summary: The on-campus Starbucks location providing coffee and snacks until mid-evening.
cards.evidence_claim: The campus Starbucks at Olmsted closes at 9:00 PM Monday through Thursday.
cards.source_title: Hubbell Dining Hall shortens hours - The Times-Delphic
cards.access_notes: Open until 9:00 PM Monday-Thursday; earlier on weekends.
